name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v5.89: the OTA publish form now has a coil/fridge app selector, so a fridge build can be published from the dashboard instead of a console call. Previously the form always targeted the coil line, so a fridge APK would have gone to the coil release. The selected app is passed to PUT app-release. Pairs with v5.88 (APKs served from our own host). Cumulative over v5.88.
